scale.source: Income Tax Act Chap. 67:01 Fifth Schedule para. 1 as replaced by Act 9 of 2008: '(c) for every dollar over 50,000 ... 36%'
scale.basis: Income Tax Act Chap. 67:01 Fifth Schedule para. 1 as replaced by Act 9 of 2008: '(c) for every dollar over 50,000 ... 36%'. A statutory amount, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act (Chap. 67:01)' confirmed: personal allowance 30,000 from 2018 (s. 47, Act 6 of 2018); 16 % to 20,000, 26 % to 50,000, 36 % above (Fifth Schedule, Act 9 of 2008); Social Security 4 % to 6,000 a month as of S.R.O. 8 of 2008 (later regulations unreachable).
